note: With --online, web retrieval searches and fetches only these sites. They are evidence sources for research, not sources of investment advice; a trusted source does not by itself support a causal link, and every excerpt still needs a stance. tier: T1 official data, regulatory filings and formal announcements; T2 news agencies; T3 other. domain follows Anthropic's allowed_domains rules: no scheme, subdomains included, ASCII only. access records checks made on 2026-10-18 from this machine with curl (browser UA) and Claude Code WebFetch; that does not guarantee Anthropic's web_fetch can reach a site. use_for, kind and exclude_summary are shown to the retrieval model.

domains.name: SEC / EDGAR
domains.use_for: US company filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1); SEC rules and press releases
domains.access: readable via WebFetch; curl needs a declared User-Agent (SEC requires contact details)

domains.name: Federal Register
domains.use_for: Text and effective dates of US federal rules: BIS export controls (Entity List etc.), tariffs, OFAC notices
domains.access: readable via curl; about 17k characters of body text; pages carry publication dates

domains.name: U.S. Commerce BIS
domains.use_for: Export-control press releases, guidance and enforcement settlements
domains.access: listing pages readable; press releases are often just a title plus a PDF link, so rule text should come from federalregister.gov

domains.name: U.S. Treasury / OFAC
domains.use_for: Sanctions (OFAC designations, general licenses), Treasury press releases, TIC data
domains.access: readable via curl (home.treasury.gov press releases, about 3k characters)

domains.name: USTR
domains.use_for: Tariffs, Section 301 investigations, trade agreements and negotiation statements

domains.name: Federal Reserve Board
domains.use_for: FOMC statements and minutes, rate decisions, statistical releases such as H.8 / H.15
domains.access: readable via curl; the press release list loads with JS, individual releases are static

domains.name: U.S. BLS
domains.use_for: Official CPI, PPI, payrolls and unemployment releases
domains.access: readable via WebFetch; curl gets 403 (bot protection); Anthropic web_fetch confirmed in live runs

domains.name: U.S. BEA
domains.use_for: Official GDP, PCE and trade balance releases
domains.access: readable via curl; about 45k characters of release text

domains.name: U.S. EIA
domains.use_for: Crude oil and natural gas: STEO forecasts, Today in Energy, inventories and prices; chokepoint background such as Hormuz
domains.access: readable via curl (already used by the hormuz pack)

domains.name: IMF
domains.use_for: World and regional economic outlooks, country reports, press releases
domains.access: readable via WebFetch; curl gets 403. PortWatch (portwatch.imf.org) is a JS app and its data cannot be fetched

domains.name: European Central Bank
domains.use_for: Euro-area rate decisions, monetary policy statements, press releases
domains.access: readable via curl; pages carry publication dates

domains.name: China Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
domains.use_for: Chinese export controls, countermeasures and spokesperson statements (including english.mofcom.gov.cn)
domains.access: readable via WebFetch; listing pages may not show dates, individual pages do

domains.name: PR Newswire
domains.use_for: Press releases issued by companies themselves (earnings, orders, partnerships). These are the company's own claims, not third-party verification
domains.access: readable via curl; pages carry publication times
domains.exclude_summary: law-firm class-action solicitations (URLs containing class-action, shareholder-alert, etc.)
domains.exclude_note: Law-firm class-action solicitations are not company announcements; the facts in them are second-hand restatements of Reuters / Bloomberg. In the 2026-10-18 Gemini 4 live run they made up half of the web excerpts. Dropped in code by URL path.

domains.name: Google official blog
domains.use_for: Official Google / Gemini product and model announcements (e.g. the Gemini 4 Argon launch)
domains.access: robots.txt allows Claude; readable via curl; article pages carry publication dates (section pages have little text, fetch individual articles)

domains.name: NVIDIA newsroom and investor relations
domains.use_for: NVIDIA product and earnings announcements (nvidianews.nvidia.com, investor.nvidia.com)
domains.access: readable via curl; about 18k characters of body text

domains.name: Focus Taiwan (CNA English)
domains.use_for: Taiwan semiconductor supply chain, TSMC and Taiwan policy news

domains.name: TrendForce
domains.use_for: Semiconductor, memory and display industry news and prices (free articles; main source of the semiconductor pack)
domains.paywall: free news readable; full research reports are paid and not fetched
domains.access: readable via curl; pages carry publication times

domains.name: Semiconductor Industry Association
domains.use_for: Global monthly semiconductor sales, industry reports, policy positions
domains.access: readable via curl; pages carry publication times

domains.name: Al Jazeera
domains.use_for: Factual reporting on the Middle East, Gulf shipping and energy facilities, filling the news-agency gap
domains.access: robots.txt allows Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot; readable via WebFetch; pages carry publication dates
